title: Billing
subtitle: Invoices, credit notes, receipts and payments in one workspace. An issued invoice can never be edited — corrections go through a credit note, and confirming a payment moves real money.

summary.paymentsPendingHint: A dealership says the money was sent
summary.overdueHint: Issued and past their due date
summary.receiptsPendingHint: Manual mark-paid, needs a second approver
summary.draftsHint: Not issued — still editable and voidable

invoices.caption: Invoices
invoices.immutabilityNote: Only a draft can be changed. Once issued, an invoice is frozen and carries a gap-free tax number — correct it with a credit note, never an edit.

empty.title: No invoices here
empty.hint: Change the filter, or draft a new invoice.

issueDialog.title: Issue this invoice?
issueDialog.warning: Issuing is irreversible. It allocates the next number in the gap-free tax series and freezes the document — after this the only correction is a credit note.

voidDialog.title: Void this draft?
voidDialog.body: The draft for {{dealer}} worth {{amount}} will be retired. Only drafts can be voided.

markPaidDialog.title: Mark this invoice paid
markPaidDialog.warning: This records the money as received and activates every subscription term the invoice covers.

create.title: New invoice draft
create.body: Nothing is issued yet — a draft carries no number and can be voided.
create.noTrn: This dealership has no TRN on file. Issuance will be refused until one is captured on its profile — a B2B tax invoice without a buyer TRN is invalid.
create.exemptionPlaceholder: Mandatory when the category is not S

detail.immutable: This document is frozen. There is no edit — issue a credit note to correct it.

creditNotes.caption: Credit notes
creditNotes.makerCheckerNote: Maker–checker: whoever submits a credit note cannot approve it. Approval issues it with a CN- number and credits the original invoice.
creditNotes.makerChecker: You submitted this — another admin must approve it.

empty.title: No credit notes here
empty.hint: Credit notes are drafted from an issued invoice.

create.title: Draft a credit note
create.amountHint: Enter it as a positive figure — the 381 type code carries the sign.
create.descriptionPlaceholder: Defaults to the original line description
create.workflow: This creates a draft. It still has to be submitted, then approved by a different admin before it is issued.

approveDialog.title: Approve and issue this credit note?
approveDialog.body: {{amount}} will be credited to {{dealer}} against invoice {{invoice}}.
approveDialog.warning: Approval issues the credit note with a gap-free CN- number and is irreversible.

rejectDialog.title: Reject this credit note?
rejectDialog.body: The {{amount}} credit will not be issued.

receipts.caption: Receipts
receipts.makerChecker: You recorded this — another admin must approve it.

empty.title: No receipts here
empty.hint: Record one when money arrives, and split it across the outstanding invoices.

create.title: Record a receipt
create.body: One payment, split across as many invoices as it covers.
create.allocationHint: Apply the money to the dealership's outstanding invoices. The server refuses an allocation larger than what an invoice still owes.
create.nothingOutstanding: This dealership has no issued invoice with a balance.
create.overAllocated: More has been allocated than was received. Reduce an allocation before saving.
create.manualHint: Sends the receipt for a second approver instead of recording it straight away.

approveDialog.title: Approve this receipt?
approveDialog.warning: Approving treats the money as received and settles the invoices it is allocated to.

rejectDialog.title: Reject this receipt?
rejectDialog.body: The {{amount}} mark-paid will not be recorded and the invoices stay outstanding.

empty.title: Nothing waiting
empty.hint: Declared transfers appear here for a human to confirm.

confirmDialog.title: Confirm the money arrived?
confirmDialog.warning: This is real money. Only confirm once you have seen the funds on the bank statement — it writes the receipt and settles the invoice.

rejectDialog.title: Reject this payment?
rejectDialog.body: {{amount}} declared by {{dealer}} will be marked as never received.
rejectDialog.placeholder: No matching credit on the bank statement
rejectDialog.hint: The payer is shown this reason.

provider.title: Payment provider
provider.presenceOnly: Presence only. Secret values live in the Super Admin vault and are never readable from here.
provider.changeWarning: Naming a provider with no credentials stops payment collection entirely rather than falling back silently.

toast.summaryFailed: Could not load the billing summary
toast.invoicePayFailed: Could not mark the invoice paid
toast.creditNoteCreateFailed: Could not draft the credit note
toast.creditNoteSubmitFailed: Could not submit the credit note
toast.creditNoteApproveFailed: Could not approve the credit note
toast.creditNoteRejectFailed: Could not reject the credit note
toast.outstandingFailed: Could not load the outstanding invoices
toast.paymentConfirmed: Payment confirmed and the invoice settled
toast.providerFailed: Could not change the payment provider
